description:

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.

With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

SAP BASIS & S/4HANA Presales

Senior Domain Architect | FJ11

Role Snapshot

**Experience**

10–15 years in SAP BASIS and HANA, including presales or solution architecture experience.

  

**Core focus**

SAP ERP and S/4HANA architecture, conversion, migration, cloud, sizing, operations, resilience, and managed services.

  

**Platforms**

Azure, AWS, GCP, on-premises, and hybrid SAP environments.

  

**Key landscape**

S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, HANA, Solution Manager, SAP cloud technologies, and integrated applications.

Job Summary

Lead end-to-end SAP BASIS and S/4HANA technical presales, shaping secure, scalable, resilient, and commercially viable architecture across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid landscapes.

Key Responsibilities

* Own technical presales from discovery and landscape assessment through architecture, sizing, estimation, proposal, client presentation, bid defense, negotiation support, and delivery handover.

* Design SAP ERP and S/4HANA target architectures, transformation of roadmaps, implementation and conversion approaches, and cloud or hybrid operating models.

* Lead S/4HANA readiness, system conversion, OS/DB migration, homogeneous and heterogeneous migration, DMO, installation, upgrade, patching, system copy, and cutover planning.

* Create SAP landscape and infrastructure designs covering compute, HANA sizing, network, storage, security, access, backup and recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and performance optimization.

* Shape SAP workloads on Azure, AWS, and GCP, including migration strategy, resilience, platform operations, and cost-conscious architecture decisions.

* Provide architecture guidance across S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, HANA, Solution Manager, SAP cloud technologies, and application or data integration.

* Define SAP BASIS managed-services solutions including L2/L3 support, platform administration, service governance, automation, DevOps, observability, continuous improvement, and operational readiness.

* Develop technical solution artifacts, assumptions, dependencies, risks, effort estimates, staffing inputs, migration waves, service descriptions, and statement-of-work content.

* Support deal governance, and strengthen reusable standards, reference architectures, accelerators, and knowledge assets.

Essential Skills

* Deep SAP BASIS, HANA, NetWeaver, Solution Manager, and S/4HANA technical architecture expertise.

* Practical experience in SAP implementation, conversion, migration, upgrades, cloud hosting, sizing, HA/DR, backup and recovery, monitoring, and performance engineering.

* Understanding operating systems, databases, networks, storage, cloud infrastructure, security, integration, and SAP DevOps toolchains.

* Strong presales capability in solution storytelling, estimation, RFP responses, architecture documentation, customer workshops, executive presentations, and technical negotiation.

* Ability to convert complex technical findings into pragmatic roadmaps, clear options, measurable outcomes, controlled risks, and executable delivery plans.

Qualifications & Attributes

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

* Minimum one end-to-end S/4HANA conversion or major SAP transformation; relevant conversion, HANA, cloud, or migration certification is preferred.

* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, customer engagement, and stakeholder-management skills.

* Self-directed, quality focused, collaborative, and able to lead cross-functional teams with limited supervision.

* Strong customer service orientation with commitment to service quality, continuous improvement, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.
  

SOFT SKILLS & SUCCESS MEASURES

* Excellent written, oral, presentation, facilitation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, estimation, decision-making, and structured problem-solving capability.

* Quality-oriented mindset with disciplined production of proposals, architectures, estimates, assumptions, and delivery-ready artifacts.

* Collaborative team players who can mobilize matrix teams, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across cultures and time zones.

title: Financial Reporting Prompt Engineer – AI & Automation
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.


Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.


That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.


Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.


For our business, for clients, and for you

  

Job Description

**Prompt Engineer – AI \& Automation**

**Job Title**


Prompt Engineer – AI \& Automation

**Department**


Global Financial Reporting

**Location**


On\-site – Pune West, Maharashtra, India

**Work Type**


Full\-time \| On\-site (no remote/hybrid)

**Function**


Finance Technology \& Automation

**ROLE SUMMARY**


The Global Financial Reporting function is investing in AI and intelligent automation to modernize how financial data is produced, reviewed, and reported. We are looking for a hands\-on Prompt Engineer to design, build and optimize the prompts, workflows and AI\-driven solutions that power this transformation.


This is a practical, delivery\-focused role for someone who genuinely understands how Large Language Models (LLMs) work and can turn business problems into reliable, production\-ready AI solutions. The successful candidate will combine deep prompt\-engineering expertise with strong Excel/VBA Macro skills, translating complex reporting and reconciliation tasks into automated, auditable outputs. Experience within Banking and Financial Services (BFS) is a strong advantage, given the regulatory and data\-sensitivity of our environment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Prompt Engineering \& AI Solution Design**

* Design, test and iterate high\-quality prompts for LLMs to support financial reporting, analysis, summarization and data extraction use cases.
* Apply advanced prompting techniques (few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, structured output, retrieval\-augmented generation) to improve accuracy, consistency and reliability.
* Build reusable prompt libraries, templates and guardrails that can be adopted across the Financial Reporting function.
* Evaluate model output systematically, reduce hallucinations, and tune solutions for factual, audit\-ready results.

**2\. Automation \& Macro Development**

* Develop and maintain Excel Macros (VBA) to automate recurring reporting, reconciliation and data\-manipulation tasks.
* Integrate AI capabilities with spreadsheet\-based and existing finance tooling to create end\-to\-end automated workflows.
* Reduce manual effort and turnaround time by standardizing and automating repetitive reporting processes.

**3\. Delivery, Testing \& Governance**

* Own solutions from concept to production, including documentation, version control, testing and handover.
* Ensure all AI and automation outputs are accurate, explainable, and compliant with data protection and internal control requirements.
* Maintain clear audit trails and adhere to security, privacy and governance standards appropriate to a regulated BFS environment.

**4\. Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with Financial Reporting, Data and Technology teams to identify and prioritise high\-value AI use cases.
* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and practical solutions.
* Stay current with developments in AI, prompt engineering and automation, and proactively recommend improvements.

description:

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Sr. Lead \- Cloud Data Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high\-performance cloud\-based data platforms that support analytics, machine learning, and enterprise data needs. This role ensures that data solutions are optimized for performance, cost, and reliability, while meeting governance, compliance, and business requirements. The engineer collaborates closely with data scientists, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver modern data capabilities on cloud platforms. Should have deep technical expertise, strong design judgment, and the ability to influence without authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Platform Engineering \& Development**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud\-native data platform infrastructure resources (e.g., AWS, Azure).
* Design and build GitHub terraform Pipeline for managing cloud data infrastructure resources and object management pipelines into the databases and SaaS product.
* Develop and optimize data pipelines patterns for ingestion, transformation, and processing of structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data.
* Build reusable frameworks and automation for data workflows, monitoring, and scaling.
* Ensure data storage and compute solutions are optimized for performance, security, and cost efficiency.
* Integrate cloud data services with enterprise applications, APIs, and third\-party tools.

### **Data Management \& Governance**

* Implement data quality, lineage, and cataloging solutions across the data platform.
* Enforce governance, security, and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2\).
* Work with architects and security teams to implement role\-based access, encryption, and audit controls.
* Support metadata management, data discoverability, and enterprise\-wide data democratization.

### **Operations \& Reliability**

* Manage the operational health of the cloud data platform, including monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines for data services and platform components.
* Implement disaster recovery, backup, and failover strategies.
* Continuously optimize platform performance, cost, and scalability.

### **Collaboration \& Innovation**

* Partner with data scientists, BI teams, and application developers to enable advanced analytics and AI/ML workloads.
* Evaluate emerging cloud data services and recommend adoption based on enterprise needs.
* Provide technical expertise in designing cloud\-based data architectures and solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in cloud engineering and data development.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education \& Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, or platform engineering with 13\+ years of total work experience in technology infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure).
* Strong experience with big data and data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Flink).
* Proven expertise in building data pipelines with tools like Apache Airflow, dbt, Kafka, or similar.

### **Skills \& Competencies:**

* In\-depth knowledge and experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or similar cloud data platforms.
* Extensive knowledge and real hands\-on experience on Github terraform pipelines and objects deployment management.
* Extensive knowledge and real hands\-on experience of AI/ML data pipelines and feature engineering.
* Exposure to regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
* Proficiency in terraform, SQL and one or more programming languages (Python, Java, or Scala).
* Deep understanding of cloud\-native data services (e.g., AWS Redshift, Glue, S3, Athena; Azure Synapse, Data Factory; GCP BigQuery, Dataflow).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
* Knowledge of FinOps principles for cost\-efficient data platform design.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Excellent communication, mentorship, and ability to influence cross\-functional teams.

**Key Success Metrics**
-----------------------

* Uptime, performance, and reliability of the cloud data platform.
* Data availability, quality, and accessibility for business and analytics use cases.
* Efficiency and scalability of data pipelines and processing.
* Cost optimization and resource utilization of cloud data services.
* Adoption and satisfaction of data platform services by business and analytics teams

**Success Indicators**
----------------------

* Stable, scalable, and secure data platforms running in production.
* Reduced data incidents and faster root‑cause resolution.
* Improved developer productivity through reusable frameworks and standards.
* Strong technical mentorship and uplift of data engineering capabilities.
* Trusted technical advisor to architecture, security, and business leadership.

Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud\-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer — setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead on call response and triage – help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
* Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership.
* Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development teamLead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms — metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing — to ensure full visibility into production systems.
* Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams.
* Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers.
* Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion.
* Build and improve on\-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on\-call rotation health to prevent burnout.
* Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production\-readiness reviews and launch checklists.
* Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision\-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection.


**Required:**


* 8\+ years of experience in scalable, distributed systems architecture.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management.

title: Business Intelligence & Reporting Consultant
description:
Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‑education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services. As a long‑standing and deeply embedded partner within the higher‑education sector, SIG brings together technical depth, operational insight, and a culture rooted in integrity, collaboration, and exceptional client service. Our heritage is built on hands‑on expertise, genuine relationships, and a commitment to delivering value with humility and excellence—values that continue to define us as we scale.

### **Business Intelligence \& Reporting Consultant**



Oracle SQL / PostgreSQL \| Client\-facing designation: Technical Consultant



Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)  

Employment Type: Full\-time (via SIG's Employer of Record in India)  

Experience: 4–7 years  

Fixed Base Compensation: ₹29\.5–₹33\.3 lakh per year



**About SIG**



Strata Information Group (SIG) is a US\-based leader in higher\-education technology consulting. We help colleges and universities modernize the systems that run their institutions — student information, HR, and finance — through ERP/SIS implementation, integration, digital transformation, CRM, and cybersecurity work.



We are building our first engineering Center of Excellence in Pune. This is a founding\-team role. You will not be joining a large delivery pool with a fixed process; you will help set how this team builds.


**The Role**



This is a hands\-on SQL and reporting role for someone who enjoys working with complex data and transforming business requirements into meaningful reports, dashboards, and data solutions.



You will work across large Oracle and PostgreSQL environments, designing data models, building reporting solutions, and supporting data warehouses that enable institutional decision\-making. While the role includes client interaction, the primary focus is on data analysis, SQL development, and business intelligence.



We are not looking for someone who has simply used SQL. We want a BI professional who can independently analyze complex schemas, build robust reporting solutions, and translate business requirements into trusted data products. Higher education experience is not required; **strong SQL, data modeling, and reporting expertise** are.
**APIs Are the Core of This Work**



If there is one thing to take from this description, it is this: your primary skill is working with APIs.



Ellucian exposes a very large API surface across its student, HR, and finance platforms. A significant part of the job is knowing that catalog — reading a business requirement, working out which APIs actually serve that function, understanding what each one returns and what it does not, and then writing the code that meets the requirement. Nobody hands you a mapping from business need to endpoint. You build that understanding, and it becomes some of the most valuable knowledge you carry.



The second half is API security. These APIs move student records, employee data, and financial transactions. You need to understand authentication and authorization flows, how tokens and scopes work, and how to request only the access an integration genuinely needs. Getting this wrong is not a bug — it is a data exposure.


*We are looking for depth here, not familiarity.* *Someone who has run a few SELECT statements will struggle. Someone who has written, tuned, and debugged complex SQL against real schemas and designed the models behind it will do well.*


**What You Will Do**


* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries in Oracle and PostgreSQL.
* Translate reporting requirements into reports, dashboards, and data extracts.
* Design and maintain data models, data warehouses, and ETL/data integration processes.
* Develop BI solutions using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar platforms.
* Validate and reconcile data across multiple systems and large relational datasets.
* Partner with clients and stakeholders to gather requirements, present solutions, and support delivery.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity and solution quality.


**Required Qualifications**


* 4–7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, SQL development, reporting, data engineering, or related fields.
* Advanced SQL expertise, including query optimization, performance tuning, indexing, and execution plans.
* Experience with Oracle SQL and/or PostgreSQL.
* Strong data modeling experience, including normalized (3NF) and dimensional/star schema design.
* Experience building or supporting data warehouses and ETL/data integration processes.
* Hands\-on experience with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with cloud data platforms and modern ETL/ELT tools.
* Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar in a professional environment.
* Experience supporting ERP, SIS, HRMS, or Finance systems.
* Prior exposure to Higher Education technology or Ellucian solutions (Banner, Colleague, ODS, EDW) is a plus, but not required.


*What we need from you is the ability to absorb a new domain fast and start contributing inside two months.*


**Working Hours**



Flexible schedule with a Tuesday \- Thursday overlap requirement of 3–4 hours with US Eastern morning, 2:00 \- 10:00 PM IST. Outside that overlap window, you manage your own hours. We care about what you deliver, not when you are logged in.


**Who Does Well Here**


* You are self\-driven. You unblock yourself, ask sharp questions, and do not wait to be assigned work.
* You are curious about the tools that make you faster, and you actually try them.
* You are comfortable being early. This team is being built now, and the process is not fully written.
* You can talk to a non\-technical client and explain what you built without making them feel lost.


 *Strata Information Group is an equal opportunity employer.*

*The listed salary range for this position is indicative and subject to adjustment based on the candidate's unique skills and location. Final compensation will be determined through mutual agreement between the successful candidate and SIG.*



SIG is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer

description:
**ABOUT US**

  

Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in professional information services, providing software and content solutions for legal, business, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance, and healthcare professionals. Serving clients in over 180 countries with operations in 40\+, the company helps professionals make confident decisions and drive results. Headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands, it employs around 21,000 people worldwide.


The Global Finance Shared Services (FSS) is a finance function designed to bring together finance and accounting professionals to streamline and enhance processes and tools. Within FSS, the Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune, India, provides centralized financial and analytical support across all Wolters Kluwer divisions. The team, comprising finance professionals and data scientists, focuses on finance reporting harmonization, technology enablement, and reporting and analytics enhancements.


In this role, you would support the Financial Shared Services (FSS) team with reporting, budgeting, and forecasting, while driving process improvements and strategic initiatives. You’d collaborate with finance leaders to enhance performance, provide insights across customer lifecycle processes, and develop revenue models to identify risks and opportunities. Additionally, you'd manage financial planning, reporting, and long\-term strategy, with a strong focus on revenue and key performance metrics.

 **SUPERVISORY RELATIONSHIPS**

 **Reports To :** Manager, Finance COE

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**

 **Education :**

* Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in finance accounting, or economics or data analytics or 3 years of experience in finance, accounting, or consulting role
* Preferred: Master’s Degree/MBA in finance or CPA, accounting, or economics or data analysis with 2 years of experience in finance, accounting, or consulting role

**Experience :**

* Experience supporting Technology and Development organizations.
* Ability to meet tight deadlines and deliver quality results.

**Technical Skills :**

* Proficient in handling large datasets and data analysis.
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas (IF, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS).
* Skilled in financial analysis, forecasting, and business performance modeling.
* Experienced in KPI development, maintenance, and reporting.
* Strong knowledge of ERP systems, experience with Tagetik and Power BI is a plus.
* Financial decision support and reporting, including cash flow, P\&L, and ad hoc reports.
* Expert in MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
* Quick to learn and adapt to new systems and tools.
* Routine use of AI\-enabled tools to support analysis, planning, forecasting, and reporting, with emphasis on applying human judgment as the final control point and ensuring data integrity in all outputs.

**Soft Skills :**

* Demonstrates strong attention to detail with problem\-solving skills.
* Self\-motivated, self\-managing and able to work independently.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

 **Financial Reporting \& Analysis:**

* Collect, organize, analyze, and interpret financial data to support business decision\-making.
* Support month\-end close activities, including preliminary reporting, accurate financial closure, and variance analysis.
* Analyze, track, and report on assigned costs and revenues against planning and forecasting benchmarks.
* Conduct cost\-per\-unit analysis to evaluate and optimize operational expenses.
* Provide insights into key business metrics across multiple functional areas.

 **Forecasting \& Budgeting:**

* Lead or assist in corporate forecasting processes, including annual budgeting and long\-range planning.
* Develop and maintain forecast models using historical trends, vendor data, and volume metrics.
* Monitor actuals versus forecasts and identify key variances and trends.

 **Revenue \& Volume Management:**

* Analyze and monitor revenue streams across customer segments and product lines.
* Support pricing strategies and identify opportunities for revenue growth.
* Understand volume impacts due to customer behavior and seasonal trends.
* Identify correlations between volume and variable costs, including temporary help and overtime.

 **System \& Process Improvement:**

* Assist in financial system transitions by understanding current tools and supporting migration to new platforms.
* Drive efficiencies in data collection and improve spreadsheet structures and update processes.
* Contribute to identifying business unit opportunities and new workflows for performance enhancement.

 **Communication \& Professionalism:**

* Communicate effectively across formats and audiences, including high\-level documentation.
* Uphold corporate values, maintain professionalism, and foster strong relationships with stakeholders.
* Execute various ad\-hoc financial and analytical projects as assigned by management.

 **Stakeholder Management:**

* Foster positive and professional relationships with all stakeholders in the workplace for effective collaboration and communication.

 **OTHER DUTIES**

  

* Proficient in advanced Excel functions (nested IFs, INDEX/MATCH, macros) for large datasets.
* Familiar with Tagetik and Microsoft Access; experience with Power BI/Tableau is a plus.
* Knowledge of statistical tools and techniques such as SAS/R, Python, time series, and regression analysis.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while managing deadlines effectively.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and adaptable to evolving roles and undefined processes.
* Flexible in adjusting communication and detail levels based on audience needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; capable of drafting high\-level documents with precision.

 **TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

  

Minimal travel might be required.

description:

**In one sentence**
-------------------

The Sourcing Manager leads strategic sourcing, negotiations and supplier management for global corporate services categories, delivering cost savings, commercial value and reduced risk while partnering closely with business stakeholders worldwide.


**All you need is...**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Economics, Business, Law or a related field. MBA preferred.
* At least 8 years of strategic sourcing and procurement experience in indirect or corporate services categories within a global organization.
* Proven track record of leading complex negotiations and delivering measurable savings on high value deals and renewals.
* Strong experience in running RFPs or tenders and evaluating technical and commercial proposals.
* Solid understanding of contract terms, commercial risk and end to end contract lifecycle management.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and suppliers across multiple regions and time zones.
* Excellent verbal and written English, with strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast paced environment.
  

**Nice to have**

  

* Hands\-on experience in Professional Services, HR and Benefits, Learning and Development, Marketing or SaaS.
* CIPS or an equivalent procurement certification.
* Experience with procurement systems such as SAP Ariba, Coupa or similar, and strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Exposure to Gen AI for procurement automation, including prompt engineering.
**What will your job look like?**
---------------------------------

* **End to end sourcing:** Lead the full sourcing lifecycle for global corporate services, from requirement gathering, supplier prequalification and RFx or tender management through negotiation, award and contract closure, to achieve the best total cost of ownership across cost, service, quality and risk.
* **Category support:** Manage sourcing activities for Professional Services, HR and Benefits, Learning and Development, IT and SaaS, and Marketing on a global basis, executing the global category strategy in alignment with category leads and procurement leadership.
* **Commercial negotiations:** Drive high impact negotiations for new deals and renewals, benchmarking proposals against the market and competing bids to deliver significant cost savings, improved commercial terms and value additions.
* **Renewal and contract management:** Manage the renewal pipeline proactively, challenge price increases, secure multiyear terms where beneficial and ensure continuity of critical services.
* **Contracting and risk:** Manage procurement agreements, including MSAs, SOWs, NDAs and order forms, in partnership with Legal, Finance and Compliance, covering commercial clauses, payment terms, bank guarantees, supplier risk and due diligence.
* **Stakeholder partnership:** Act as a trusted business partner to HR, Finance, Legal, IT and business leaders globally, translating their needs into sourcing plans and influencing senior stakeholders with a business enabler mindset.
* **Leadership governance:** Prepare and present deal review decks and sourcing recommendations, including CBA, procurement leadership and senior management for approval.
* **P2P management:** Oversee the purchase to pay process for the categories managed, working with procurement services and accounts teams to ensure timely PR and PO issuance, vendor onboarding and payments in line with contractual commitments.
* **Supplier relationship management:** Conduct periodic business reviews with key suppliers to track performance, manage risks, resolve escalations, and identify improvement opportunities.
* **Market intelligence:** Maintain strong knowledge of supply markets, pricing trends and supplier innovations to identify new cost reduction and value creation opportunities.
* **Reporting:** Track and report savings, spend, pipeline and procurement of KPIs to management on a regular basis.
* **Process improvement:** Drive efficiency in procurement workflows, including the use of Gen AI tools and templates to automate routine sourcing and negotiation tasks.
**Why you will love this job:**
-------------------------------

* You will work in a highly diverse, multicultural and fast growing global organization.
* You will manage high visibility deals and work closely with senior leadership.
* You will be part of an experienced procurement team with strong learning opportunities.
* You will support a market leading software and services company for the communications and media industry.

With our talented people, and more than forty years of experience running mission\-critical systems around the globe, Amdocs runs billions of transactions daily. Our technology is relied on every day, connecting people worldwide and advancing a more inclusive, connected world. Together, we help those who shape the future to make it amazing. Amdocs is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market (NASDAQ: DOX) and reported revenue of $4\.53 billion in fiscal 2025\. For more information, visit www.amdocs.com

title: Senior Member of Technical Staff- Machine Learning
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

**Machine Learning Engineer — Senior Member of Technical Staff (Senior Associate)**

 **Role summary:**  



  

You will design, build, and deploy advanced machine learning and deep learning solutions that improve clinical and operational outcomes for healthcare providers. This in\-person role is based in Pune, India and requires 3–5 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with product, data, and platform engineering teams to move models from research to production and will report to the Senior Engineering Manager.

 **Team summary:**  



  

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join the Data Science team within the Athena Clinicals Division. You will work with the team to develop and deploy machine learning models across a variety of healthcare products and domains.

  

The data science team is bringing machine learning to bear against the hardest problems in healthcare. We partner with product managers, clinicians, and engineering teams to translate clinical and operational problems into measurable ML use cases. Our work spans the full model lifecycle: exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model development, rigorous evaluation, reproducibility, automated training pipelines, and monitored production deployments. The team applies a range of methods — from traditional supervised learning to modern deep learning and generative AI — to solve problems such as document understanding, clinical NLP, clinician workflows, etc. We place a strong emphasis on model safety, explainability, and measurable impact on care delivery and practice operations. The team works hand\-in\-hand with platform engineers to deploy state\-of\-the\-art models using cloud technologies and production orchestration (CI/CD, containerization, orchestration), and we aim to make ML deliverable, observable, and maintainable at scale across athenahealth’s product portfolio.

 **About you:**  



  

You enjoy owning end\-to\-end technical work and solving challenging problems. You keep up with advances in machine learning, especially deep learning and generative AI, and apply them thoughtfully to real\-world product needs. You have hands\-on experience building, evaluating, and deploying ML and deep learning models, and are comfortable communicating results and trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. You write clean, well\-documented code, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to produce reliable, auditable solutions. You are motivated by improving healthcare outcomes using data and models.

 **Essential Job Responsibilities:**

* Develop production\-ready machine learning and deep learning models using Python and relevant libraries.
* Implement and evaluate complex neural network architectures (NLP and/or computer vision) for healthcare use cases.
* Design and build data pipelines and feature engineering workflows
* Integrate models into scalable production environments using containerization and orchestration patterns.
* Optimize model performance, conduct error analysis, and design rigorous validation and monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with product managers, clinicians, and engineers to translate clinical problems into measurable ML solutions and acceptance criteria.
* Evaluate and adopt deep learning frameworks, transformer\-based models, and foundational model techniques (LLMs/GenAI) to solve product problems.
* Apply prompt engineering and optimization practices to improve generative AI outputs and alignment with product requirements.
* AI competency expectation: Integrate AI and generative\-model capabilities into development workflows—evaluate new AI tools and model variants for product fit, prototype responsible uses, and recommend best practices for safe, reliable deployment of AI features that enhance clinical and operational decision\-making.
* Communicate technical trade\-offs, design decisions, and model limitations clearly in writing and presentations.

 **Additional Job Responsibilities:**

* Research and prototype novel model architectures or training strategies relevant to product goals.
* Support model fine\-tuning and transfer learning workflows for domain\-specific LLM models.
* Contribute to internal tooling and shared libraries for reproducible training and evaluation.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and cross\-team technical discussions.
* Help define data collection and labeling priorities in partnership with product and annotation teams.
* Contribute to documentation for model governance, reproducibility, and runbooks for on\-call support.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
* Assist in performance tuning and cost optimization for training and inference workloads.
* Participate in security and privacy reviews related to model data and deployment.
* Attend and contribute to community discussions on ML safety, fairness, and responsible AI practices.

 **Expected Education \& Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience building and deploying machine learning or deep learning models in production.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Unix/Linux environments.
* Experience developing and implementing deep learning models with complex neural network architectures.
* Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch or TensorFlow), transformer models, and libraries for NLP/vision.
* Experience with LLMs, generative AI techniques, and prompt engineering; training and fine\-tuning LLMs.
* Familiarity with NLP or computer vision techniques and evaluation metrics.
* Experience with cloud environments and infrastructure is a must ; Hands on working knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Harness, EKS is a must
* Strong verbal and written communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder\-facing documentation.

 ***About athenahealth***

***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*

***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*

***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*

***What we can do for you:***

*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.*

*We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.*

*In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*

*Learn more about our culture and benefits here:* *athenahealth.com/careers*

*https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal\-opportunity*

title: Customer Care Communications Analyst
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

The Customer Care team is an extension of Workday Support. We are driven by our excitement in providing customers an extraordinary support experience! Our team is comprised of a diverse mix of backgrounds and experiences working towards the goal of helping our customers succeed. We have teams based out of California, Texas, and Georgia in the US, Ireland in the EMEA region, New Zealand in the APAC region, Pune, India!
**About the Role**

**As a Customer Care Communications, you will be part of a dedicated team focused on delivering fast, clear, and effective support to our customers. In this versatile role, you will manage incoming cases, resolve customer inquiries, and serve as a vital link between our customers and internal teams in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.**

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid (Minimum 50% in\-office attendance required)  

  



**What You’ll Do**

* **Case Management:** Manage an incoming case queue, resolving customer issues accurately and within established service\-level timeframes.
* **Customer Communication:** Communicate clearly, concisely, and empathetically with customers across both written and verbal channels.
* **Team Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with fellow Customer Care analysts to ensure all customer inquiries are systematically tracked and followed up on efficiently.
* **Internal Liaison:** Act as the primary bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring customer needs are thoroughly understood and addressed.
* **Issue Escalation:** Identify, prioritize, and escalate sensitive or complex customer issues to appropriate partners as they arise.

**About You**

* **3 years of experience** in a customer service, client support, or customer care operations role.
* **Strong Communicator \& Collaborator:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of building positive, trust\-based relationships with customers and colleagues.
* **Thrives Under Pressure:** Proven ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and maintain high accuracy in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* **Adaptable \& Agile:** Highly adaptable to changing priorities, processes, and business needs with a continuous improvement mindset.
* **Analytical \& Resourceful:** Comfortable interpreting and synthesizing data from multiple sources to inform decisions, research customer issues, and drive them to resolution.
* **Organized \& Detail\-Oriented:** Highly organized, with strong attention to detail when managing customer data and record\-keeping.
* **Adaptable Learner:** Quick to pick up new internal tools, operational concepts, and workflow processes.

**Nice to Have**

* **Experience working with CRM or ticketing platforms such as Salesforce, Jira, or similar tools.**

  

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**  



With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). **Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1745342
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Technology \- Consulting – Commercial analytics and Forecasting – Senior Consultant/Asst Manager – Life Sciences Sector**

  


**The opportunity**



We are seeking an experienced Pharma Forecasting Specialist to join our team. The role involves working as a key stakeholder within a cross\-functional team to deliver forecasts at the global, regional, and country levels based on business needs.



The ideal candidate will have 7\+ years of pharmaceutical forecasting experience, strong therapeutic area (TA) expertise, and the ability to develop forecasting assumptions, create concept notes, and prepare impactful presentations. Basic proficiency in Python is required to support forecasting and analytical activities.

  


**Your key responsibilities**



As a Senior Consultant/Asst. Manager in Commercial analytics and Forecasting, you will work as a key stakeholder within a cross\-functional team to deliver forecasts at the global, regional, and country levels based on business needs.

  


**In this pivotal role, you will:**


* Develop and maintain short\-term and long\-term brand forecasts to support strategic and operational planning.
* Conduct brand, franchise, regional, and country\-level forecasting, providing actionable business insights and recommendations.
* Apply quantitative and analytical techniques to solve forecasting challenges and perform sensitivity analyses to assess risks and opportunities.
* Build, validate, and enhance forecasting models, recommending appropriate assumptions and methodologies.
* Analyze historical performance, market dynamics, and business drivers to improve forecast accuracy.
* Prepare concept notes, reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate insights and recommendations effectively.
* Present findings to internal stakeholders and senior leadership to support decision\-making.
* Leverage Python and analytics tools to automate and optimize forecasting processes.
* Drive continuous improvement by adopting best practices, innovative methodologies, and emerging forecasting technologies

  


**Overall delivery**


* Conduct brand, franchise, regional, and country\-level forecasting, providing actionable business insights and recommendations.
* Analyze historical performance, market dynamics, and business drivers to improve forecast accuracy.
* Prepare concept notes, reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate insights and recommendations effectively.
* Present findings to internal stakeholders and senior leadership to support decision\-making.

  


**Practice development**


* Contribute to the growth and strategic direction of EY’s Pharma Customer practice.
* Develop thought leadership assets, including POVs, POCs, proposals, and go\-to\-market materials to support business development.
* Identify opportunities to expand EY’s capabilities and deliver innovative solutions for pharmaceutical clients.
* Stay current with pharmaceutical industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies.
* Identify and support new business opportunities within the life sciences and pharmaceutical sectors

  


**Stakeholder management**


* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders, including Marketing, Finance, Market Access, MMD, HHI, and RCL teams, to gather requirements and deliver forecasting solutions.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, actionable, and sustainable solutions.
* Drive stakeholder alignment to ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction

  


**Team and People development**


* Lead, coach, and mentor team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high\-performing talent with expertise in pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics.
* Create and execute development plans to support career growth and capability building.
* Strengthen team expertise in therapeutic areas, pharmaceutical sciences, strategic thinking, project management, and leadership.
* Foster an inclusive, agile, and high\-performance team environment.
* Evaluate and manage team performance, providing regular feedback and development opportunities

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


**To excel in this role, you will need:**


* 7\+ years of pharmaceutical forecasting experience.
* Strong therapeutic area (TA) expertise.
* Ability to develop forecasting assumptions, create concept notes, and prepare impactful presentations.
* Basic proficiency in Python to support forecasting and analytical activities


**Experience:**


* 7\+ years of experience in pharmaceutical forecasting, commercial analytics, and business analysis within the life sciences industry.
* Extensive experience in developing, maintaining, and enhancing forecasting models to support strategic and operational decision\-making across global markets.
* Strong expertise in Long\-Range Forecasting (LRF), forecasting methodologies, scenario planning, and sensitivity analysis.
* Proven experience in business analysis, including requirements gathering, data management, process optimization, change management, and executive\-level presentations.
* Deep therapeutic area expertise in Oncology, Vaccines, Immunology, Rare Diseases, or other pharmaceutical disciplines.
* Demonstrated track record of delivering robust forecasts and actionable business insights at global, regional, and country levels.
* Extensive experience collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders, including Commercial, Finance, Market Access, Medical Affairs, HEOR, and Strategic Planning teams.
* Proficiency in forecasting and analytics platforms such as SQL, Tableau, Alteryx, Power BI, and other data processing tools.
* Strong working knowledge of Python for analytics, forecasting, process automation, and advanced modeling applications.
* Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and advanced statistical techniques applied to forecasting and commercial decision\-making
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data into strategic business recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership and client executives.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, lead complex projects, and deliver high\-quality outcomes in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated success working with global and cross\-functional teams across geographies and organizational levels.
* Strong leadership presence, business acumen, and ownership mindset, with a focus on driving client value and delivery excellence.
* Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and the adoption of emerging technologies and best practices in pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics.
* Experience leading and mentoring high\-performing teams while fostering a culture of collaboration, capability development, and continuous improvement.
* Track record of contributing to business development, proposal support, thought leadership, and practice\-building initiatives


**Skillsets:**


* Data Tools: MS Excel, MS PowerPoint
* Visualization Tools: Power BI

title: Engineer I - Internal IT
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.

**Job Title : Engineer I \- End User Technology Operations,**

**Location :Pune \- Onsite**

  

Role Purpose  

As Engineer I \- End User Technology Operations at Accelya, you will support end\-user computing operations, device lifecycle management and IT service desk support activities, maintaining infrastructure services and contributing to the reliability and security of our enterprise IT environment across 10 global offices.  

  

Duties \& Responsibilities  

* Provide day\-to\-day operational support and maintenance for end\-user computing operations, device lifecycle management and IT service desk support, resolving incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs
* Monitor end\-user computing operations, device lifecycle management and IT service desk support health using observability tools, escalating anomalies to senior engineers

* Use generative AI (Claude, ChatGPT or equivalent, Microsoft Copilot) for technical documentation, runbook creation and incident report drafting
* Participate in on\-call rotation and support escalation or equivalent processes as required

  

Required Experience \& Skills  

* 2 years of experience in End User Technology Operations or a closely related IT infrastructure role
* Good foundational knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Azure AD/Entra ID, ServiceNow ITSM, remote support tools and ITIL\-aligned IT service desk operations
* Understanding of ITIL service management principles and incident/change management processes
* Strong problem\-solving, documentation and communication skills
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field; relevant entry\-level certifications preferred

  

Preferred Experience \& Skills  

* Experience using ServiceNow AI or equivalent, Microsoft Copilot and Claude/ChatGPT or equivalent for AI\-powered IT service desk automation, intelligent incident resolution and self\-service IT support for AI\-assisted infrastructure management, documentation and incident investigation
* Familiarity with AWS cloud services relevant to Accelya's AWS partnership
* Use of generative AI (Claude, ChatGPT or equivalent, Microsoft Copilot) for runbook creation, technical documentation and incident analysis
* Awareness of how AI is transforming IT operations including AIOps, intelligent monitoring and automated incident resolution
* Experience using Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 and AI\-powered self\-service tools to reduce IT support contacts and improve end\-user productivity

  

What do we offer?  

* An open culture with a creative and challenging opportunity to satisfy your intellectual needs
* Flexible working hours
* Smart working: a hybrid remote/office working environment
* Work\-life balance
* An excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment to work in

  

About Accelya  

Accelya is a leading global software provider to the airline industry, powering over 200 airlines with an open, modular software platform. Owned by Vista Equity Partners, we bring together 2,000\+ employees across 10 global offices. We are proud partners of AWS and pioneers in NDC expertise. Find out more at www.accelya.com
What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

**Position:** SOC Analyst (Level 1 / Level 2\)  
**Location:** Pune/ Office  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** SOC Manager

**About the Role**

We are looking for a SOC Analyst to join our Security Operations Center. You will monitor, investigate, and respond to security events across client environments, working with a mix of enterprise tools and cloud platforms. This role demands equal parts technical depth and communication clarity — you will be the person clients and internal stakeholders hear from during an incident, and your written reports need to be as sharp as your investigation skills.

**What You Will Do**

* Monitor security alerts across SIEM, EDR, email security, and DNS filtering platforms on a continuous basis
* Triage and investigate security events, distinguishing true positives from false positives with documented rationale
* Respond to and contain incidents per defined runbooks, escalating Sev 1 and Sev 2 events to senior analysts and the CISO
* Produce clear, concise incident reports for both technical audiences and non\-technical stakeholders — executives should be able to read your summary without a security background
* Communicate proactively with clients during active incidents: status updates, containment actions taken, next steps, timelines
* Conduct phishing email analysis and report findings through defined channels
* Perform log analysis across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, AWS CloudTrail, and endpoint management platforms
* Maintain accurate, real\-time documentation in ticketing systems throughout every investigation
* Participate in post\-incident reviews and contribute to runbook improvements
* Support vulnerability tracking and coordinate patch status updates with system owners

**What We're Looking For**

**Technical Skills**

* 1–3 years in a SOC, helpdesk security, or IT security role (Level 1\); 3–5 years for Level 2
* Hands\-on experience with SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 security tools — Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Purview Audit, Entra ID sign\-in logs
* Understanding of common attack frameworks: MITRE ATT\&CK, kill chain methodology
* Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals — DNS, HTTP/S, TCP/IP, firewall logs
* Experience reading and interpreting Windows Event Logs, Azure/Entra sign\-in logs, and email headers
* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS or Azure) is an advantage

**Communication Skills — Non\-Negotiable**

* Writes clearly and professionally in English — no jargon when the audience doesn't need it
* Can produce an incident summary that a CFO or CEO can act on, and a technical timeline that an engineer can follow
* Comfortable giving real\-time verbal updates to clients during active incidents, including delivering bad news calmly and clearly
* Responds promptly and transparently — stakeholders are never left wondering what is happening
* Understands that communication during an incident is itself a security control

**Mindset and Behaviour**

* Stays calm under pressure — incidents are not the time to go quiet or speculate publicly
* Curious and methodical — follows evidence, not assumptions
* Takes ownership of tickets end\-to\-end; does not hand off without context
* Asks good questions when scope is unclear rather than proceeding on assumptions
* Collaborative — works effectively across time zones with US and India teams

**Preferred Certifications**

* CompTIA Security\+
* SC\-200 (Microsoft Security Operations Analyst)
* CISA
* GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler) — Level 2

Pay: ₹280,000\.00 \- ₹350,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pune, Maharashtra 411046

**Your key responsibilities**

  

**AI \& Agentic Systems Engineering**

Apply tools such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent frameworks where suitable.

Translate prioritized business and investment challenges into scalable technical architectures and production\-ready AI services.

**Generative AI, RAG \& AI Platform Engineering**

* Support the development of LLM\-powered applications using leading commercial and open\-source models and platforms, such as Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Hugging Face or equivalent, applying prompt engineering, structured outputs, reasoning frameworks and autonomous workflows.
* Design retrieval\-augmented generation solutions using semantic and hybrid search, embeddings, enterprise knowledge bases, metadata enrichment, reranking and retrieval\-quality optimization. Use vector databases, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Azure AI Search or equivalent services where beneficial.

Establish LLMOps capabilities covering prompt lifecycle management, model evaluation, observability, performance and cost monitoring, testing, validation and responsible AI controls. Apply tools such as MLflow, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry or equivalent platforms where appropriate.

**Full\-Stack, Data \& Cloud Engineering**

* Develop modern React and TypeScript front ends and Python\- or Java\-based back\-end services, APIs and microservices, using frameworks such as FastAPI, Spring Boot or equivalent.
* Build reliable data and analytics solutions using BigQuery and PostgreSQL, supported by cloud\-native, event\-driven and distributed architectures.

Embed engineering excellence through automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization, observability, monitoring, logging and site reliability practices, using Git, GitHub or Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and relevant testing frameworks.  

* 

  

**Machine Learning \& Financial Analytics**

* Aid the design predictive and analytical models, including classification, ranking, recommendation and forecasting solutions, using appropriate supervised and unsupervised learning methods and established Python ML libraries such as scikit\-learn, PyTorch or equivalent.
* Apply feature engineering, model explainability and robust validation to deliver transparent, decision\-relevant analytics, using tools such as SHAP or equivalent where appropriate.

Bring practical understanding of asset management, investment products and performance and risk measures to the design of relevant solutions.  

* 

  

**Collaboration**

* Support the definition of technical strategy, architecture and reusable engineering patterns for AI\-powered products and platforms, while enabling the translation of prototypes from proof of concept to enterprise deployment.

Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, use case owners and control functions to align priorities, manage trade\-offs and deliver measurable outcomes.  



**Your skills and experience**

Hands\-on software engineering experience, including the design and delivery of enterprise\-scale distributed applications and production\-grade AI or Generative AI solutions.


* Expertise in ReactJS and TypeScript, combined with strong Python or Java engineering skills and practical experience with API, microservices and asynchronous application design; experience with FastAPI, Spring Boot or comparable frameworks is beneficial.
* Experience with BigQuery and PostgreSQL, cloud\-native architectures, Git\-based development, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, observability and automated testing; practical knowledge of GitHub or Azure DevOps, Terraform and OpenTelemetry is beneficial.
* Practical expertise in LLM applications, AI agents, RAG architectures, vector databases, semantic or hybrid search, model evaluation and LLMOps, with hands\-on experience in relevant orchestration, evaluation and observability tools.

* Strong understanding of financial markets and investment products is highly desirable, with experience in asset management, ETFs or mutual funds and knowledge of key investment performance and risk metrics, including Sharpe Ratio, Information Ratio, Sortino Ratio, Alpha, Beta and Tracking Error.

* Strong engineering mindset and ownership mentality, with sound judgement and the ability to structure ambiguity, solve complex problems, make pragmatic technical decisions and balance delivery speed, quality, risk, maintainability and long\-term scalability.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to understand business needs, translate them into clear technical choices, manage expectations, influence decisions and build trusted relationships across business, product, technology and control functions.
* Ability to support the delivery across the engineering lifecycle, establish fit\-for\-purpose standards and working practices, co\-manage dependencies and trade\-offs, and maintain focus on measurable business and user outcomes.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

title: Lead Consultant - S/4 HANA FICO
description:

Pune, MH, IN Pune, IN
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.

  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.

  

**We are looking forward to hire S/4 HANA FICO Professionals in the following areas :**

  

**Role Purpose**


Own the delivery and support of the integrated Finance (FI) and Controlling (CO) solution across an 18\-company\-code, multi\-country S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition landscape. This is a hands\-on senior role for someone who can move fluently between statutory finance and management accounting — closing the loop from raw\-material cost through product cost to margin and consolidated group results — and who can lead a workstream through SIT, data migration, cutover, and hypercare rather than advise from the sidelines.


**Key Responsibilities — Finance (FI)**


* Own the FI configuration validation across G/L, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, and Bank Accounting for all in\-scope company codes, on the S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA) model.
* Design and govern the multi\-country chart of accounts, ledger and currency setup, and parallel valuation (group/IFRS and local GAAP), including document splitting and the non\-leading ledger design.
* Lead intercompany accounting design, including the Germany–Luxembourg principal model and cross\-company\-code postings across the 18 entities.
* Own period\-end and financial\-close design and orchestration, including tax, withholding, and country\-specific statutory and e\-invoicing/compliance requirements across NA, EU, KSA, India, and Mexico.
* Direct the AP automation agenda — invoice ingestion, three\-way match, MIRO/FB60 posting, and document archiving — and its finance\-side controls, working with the BTP/automation team.

**Key Responsibilities — Controlling (CO)**


* Own the CO design across Cost Element, Cost Center, Internal Order, Profitability Analysis (margin analysis on the Universal Journal), and Product Costing.
* Lead Product Cost Planning and the cost estimate / costing\-run design (BOM\- and routing\-driven cost build\-up, activity rates), including its use in cost\-plus sales pricing (EK02 / margin\-condition design).
* Own Material Ledger and Actual Costing design and activation — including the migration and mock\-cycle issues that come with it — given standard\-price valuation and multi\-currency requirements.
* Design overhead, settlement, and period\-end CO close, and the PP/CO and PS/CO integration (production and project cost flows).

**Key Responsibilities — Group Reporting \& Integration**


* Own or co\-own SAP Group Reporting (S/4HANA Consolidation) design: consolidation units/groups, FS\-item mapping, currency translation, and intercompany elimination.
* Ensure clean FI\-CO integration and cross\-module integrity with MM (procurement/inventory valuation, GR/IR), SD (revenue, COGS, billing), PP (production cost), PM, PS, and EWM.
* Own the finance number\-range, master\-data, and org\-structure readiness across all company codes.

**Delivery Responsibilities**


* Lead the FICO workstream through SIT, UAT, and integration testing — authoring and executing test cases and driving defect resolution to closure.
* Own FICO data migration design and mock\-cycle execution (asset balances, open items, cost master data, Material Ledger), resolving load errors and reconciling migrated balances.
* Own cutover planning and execution for finance, and lead hypercare and the first statutory close post\-go\-live.
* Produce and maintain BRDs, functional specs for RICEFW objects, and configuration documentation to program standards.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**


* 10\+ years SAP FICO, with at least 3–4 full\-cycle implementations where the individual personally owned both FI and CO (not one or the other).
* Demonstrable depth in S/4HANA (not just ECC) — Universal Journal, New Asset Accounting, and the S/4 finance data model — ideally on Private Cloud Edition / RISE.
* Hands\-on Product Costing and Material Ledger / Actual Costing experience — a firm requirement, not a nice\-to\-have, given the manufacturing (polymer compounding) context.
* Multi\-company\-code, multi\-country, multi\-currency delivery experience, including parallel ledgers and local statutory/tax requirements.
* SAP Group Reporting (or a comparable SAP consolidation tool) design experience.
* Strong FI\-CO integration knowledge and working fluency with the MM/SD/PP touchpoints that drive finance postings.
* Professional accounting qualification (CA / CPA / CMA / ACCA or equivalent) strongly preferred — someone who understands the accounting, not only the configuration.
* Proven ability to lead a workstream and coordinate with cross\-functional module leads, an implementation partner, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred / Differentiators**


* Manufacturing or process\-industry finance experience (chemicals, polymers, or similar).
* Exposure to SAP BTP\-based finance automation (Document AI / DOX, Build Process Automation) and finance\-relevant Fiori app design.
* KSA e\-invoicing (ZATCA), India GST, and Mexico CFDI familiarity.
* Experience through a go\-live cutover and first statutory/consolidated close on S/4HANA.

**Key Competencies**


Bridges statutory finance and management accounting fluently; strong reconciliation and problem\-solving discipline; clear communicator across business and technical audiences; comfortable owning ambiguity and driving decisions to closure under a fixed go\-live date

  

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

  

**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**


* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture
