title: Integration Principal
description:
**INTEGRATION PRINCIPAL**



(Pune)


*Founded in 2000, Ivalua is a leading global provider of cloud\-based procurement solutions.*


**COMPANY OVERVIEW**



At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionises supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration.



We achieve this through our leading cloud\-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities.



Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn.


**THE OPPORTUNITY**


**CONTEXT**:



You will be part of the Professional Services Team whose mission is to successfully deliver our unique and configurable solution to customers and support our Partner community with high quality standards and a strong commitment to excellence and efficiency. Our team is very hands\-on with a strong mindset of problem\-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long\-term challenges. The Data Intelligence division within this team focuses specifically on the pillars of system integrations, advanced Power BI reporting, and end\-to\-end spend management data solutions.


**ROLE**:



We are seeking a highly technical, hands‑on, and detail‑oriented Principal Integration professional to lead the **most complex, hands‑on integration designs and builds** across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission‑critical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.



You will act as the go‑to integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).



This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO WITH US**


**Integration Design \& Implementation**


* *End‑to‑End Integration Design:* Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other third‑party systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
* *Hands‑On Build:* Configure and develop integrations using Ivalua tools, APIs, ETL/EAI/middleware, file‑based interfaces and scripting where needed. Own technical implementation from design through deployment for the highest‑complexity streams.
* *Standards \& Reuse:* Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* *Performance \& Robustness:* Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* *Troubleshooting \& Debugging:* Act as the top‑level technical escalation point for integration‑related incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, go‑live and hypercare phases.


**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**


* *Work with Functional \& Technical Teams:* Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Project Managers to align integration design with business processes and data models.
* *Customer Technical Workshops:* Lead or co‑lead technical workshops with customers' IT and integration teams on the most strategically significant or technically ambiguous engagements, to capture integration requirements, present solution options, and validate technical designs.
* *R\&D Feedback:* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams on integration capabilities, feature gaps, and improvement opportunities encountered across the portfolio.
* *Pre‑Sales Support:* Provide technical input on the most complex or high‑risk proposals — contributing to solution design, effort estimation, and technical due diligence for prospective clients where deep integration expertise is needed to de‑risk the deal.


**Delivery Excellence**


* *Technical Specifications:* Produce high‑quality, reference‑standard technical design documents (integration specification, mapping documents, sequence diagrams) and keep them up to date.
* *Quality Assurance:* Define the org's unit, integration, and regression testing standards and frameworks, and perform peer reviews of integration designs and implementations across projects.
* *Risk \& Issue Management:* Identify systemic integration risks (e.g., recurring dependencies, data quality patterns, performance constraints) and partner with project teams to define and drive mitigation plans at the practice level.
* *Lifecycle Support:* Support cutover planning, go‑live readiness, and post‑go‑live stabilization from an integration standpoint, including monitoring and early‑life support for the most critical engagements.


**Partner \& Internal Enablement**


* *Technical Mentor:* Informally mentor and coach Senior Integration Leads and junior integration/technical consultants by sharing best practices, code samples, troubleshooting techniques and design approaches.
* *Partner Guidance:* Provide technical guidance to partners' integration consultants on specific projects, clarifying Ivalua integration patterns, constraints and recommended approaches.
* *Knowledge Assets:* Contribute to internal knowledge base articles, how‑to guides, reference implementations, and sample configurations to accelerate future projects.


**YOUR PROFILE**



If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:


**Required Skills**


* Minimum 10 years of experience in technical integration, technical consulting, or web‑based software development, ideally in SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
* Significant hands‑on experience designing and implementing integrations using ETL/EAI or other integration/middleware technologies.
* Strong practical experience with SOAP and REST APIs, including API consumption, design principles, authentication methods, and error handling.
* Solid understanding of data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP, FTPS, API‑based, file‑based) and data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON (experience with cXML/EDI a plus).
* Proficient with relational databases and SQL (e.g., SQL Server or equivalent): able to write and tune complex queries, perform data analysis, and investigate performance issues.
* Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve most the complex integration problems across applications, middleware, and databases.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to data integrity, security and long‑term maintainability.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical topics to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, and leading technical working sessions with senior client and internal stakeholders. .
* Comfortable working in a customer‑facing Professional Services or consulting environment, managing multiple workstreams and priorities.
* A Bachelor's (BS) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field or foreign equivalent is required.
* Ability and willingness to travel as needed (\~10–20%, depending on project needs).


**Preferred Skills**


* Experience in Procurement / Source‑to‑Pay (S2P), finance, or supply chain domains.
* Experience working with or alongside Systems Integrators (SIs) or consulting partners on integration topics.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and integration services (iPaaS, API gateways, message queues, event‑driven architectures).
* Familiarity with using automation or AI‑assisted tools for mapping, testing, or monitoring integrations.
* Relevant technical certifications in integration/middleware, cloud, or enterprise applications.


**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**



If your application fits this specific position's needs, our skilled Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial screening call. Get one step closer to achieving your goals – apply today!



Our Talent team will guide you through every step of the interview process \- from preparation to completion. They're here to support you!

Interviews will be conducted virtually via video or on\-site with face\-to\-face meetings.

**About this role**
-------------------



We are seeking an experienced Telecom Billing Operations professional to provide hands\-on Level 2 Application Operations leadership across telecom billing platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring the successful execution of bill runs, invoice processing, call/CDR processing, reconciliation activities, discrepancy management, incident restoration, operational governance, automation and continual service improvement. The position plays a critical role in maintaining billing accuracy, service reliability, SLA compliance and operational excellence, while supporting approved AI and AIOps initiatives to enhance monitoring, detection and troubleshooting capabilities.


Location: SP Infocity, Pune

**What you will do**
--------------------



Billing Operations \& Bill Run Processing  

* Own the day\-to\-day operational health and technical support of billing processes within the assigned service scope.
* Execute and monitor pre\-bill checks, bill preparation, bill production, bill generation, customer notifications and billing cycle closure activities.
* Troubleshoot bill run failures, rejected accounts, long\-running jobs, scheduler issues, database constraints and billing exceptions.
* Conduct post\-bill validations, billed\-account verification, reconciliation checks and exception management to support accurate cycle completion.


Invoice Posting \& Downstream Processing  

* Monitor invoice generation, validation, posting, extraction and delivery to downstream document management, printing and reporting systems.
* Investigate invoice rejections, posting failures, balance mismatches, missing outputs and invoice\-data issues.
* Coordinate recovery actions and validate invoice controls before billing cycle closure.


Call / CDR Processing  

* Monitor daily call, event and CDR processing, including rating, re\-rating, backlog management and suspended or rejected records.
* Troubleshoot data\-quality, validation, processing\-chain, throughput and capacity\-related issues.
* Coordinate controlled recycling and reprocessing activities following established procedures and operational controls.


Discrepancy Management \& Billing Assurance  

* Analyse discrepancies across customer, product, discount, billing profile, usage, invoice, payment and accounts receivable data.
* Perform and coordinate reconciliations across CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing and downstream systems.
* Identify recurring mismatch patterns and billing risks, driving corrective and preventive actions through Problem Management processes.


Incident, Problem, SLA \& Service Management  

* Lead Level 2 incident triage and service restoration activities for priority billing incidents.
* Collaborate with specialist teams, vendors and stakeholders to resolve complex operational issues.
* Drive root\-cause analysis, known\-error management and corrective action implementation.
* Monitor SLA and KPI performance, incident ageing, MTTR, operational risks and service backlogs.


Automation, AI \& Continual Improvement  

* Automate operational activities including health checks, reconciliations, batch monitoring, validations and reporting using Shell scripting, SQL and approved tools.
* Enhance observability through dashboards, proactive alerting and operational monitoring improvements.
* Leverage approved AI and AIOps capabilities to support anomaly detection, event correlation, incident triage, knowledge retrieval and root\-cause analysis, with appropriate governance and human oversight.
* Maintain and deliver a continual\-improvement backlog focused on operational efficiency, billing accuracy and reduction of manual effort.


Operational Governance \& Knowledge Management  

* Provide operational reporting and stakeholder updates covering service health, incidents, billing cycles, discrepancies and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain runbooks, operational procedures, billing calendars, recovery instructions, audit artefacts and knowledge repositories.
* Support capability development by coaching colleagues on billing processes, troubleshooting techniques and operational best practice.
**Who you are**
---------------



Essential Experience  

* 7\+ years of Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise billing Application Operations experience with significant hands\-on production support responsibility.
* Proven experience in bill run processing, invoice posting and processing, call/CDR processing and billing discrepancy management.
* Experience managing priority incidents, service restoration, SLA\-driven support and root\-cause analysis activities.
* Experience investigating billing failures, processing backlogs, invoice exceptions and cross\-system reconciliation issues.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and cross\-functional coordination skills.


Technical Expertise  

* Telecom billing platforms such as Oracle BRM, Amdocs, Kenan, Geneva/SingleView, BSCS or equivalent solutions.
* Bill run management including bill preparation, generation, validation, re\-run activities and cycle closure.
* Invoice processing, validation, extraction, posting and downstream delivery monitoring.
* Call and CDR processing, rating, re\-rating, rejected\-record management and throughput analysis.
* Unix/Linux administration and Shell scripting.
* Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for troubleshooting, reconciliation and operational automation.
* Batch scheduling, application log analysis, database performance investigation and file\-processing operations.
* Integration awareness across CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing, payment, reporting and document\-management platforms.


Monitoring \& Service Management  

* Experience with observability and monitoring solutions such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, Zabbix or similar tools.
* Knowledge of Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request Management processes.
* Understanding of ITIL principles and SLA/KPI\-driven operational support.


Desirable Experience  

* SRE practices, resilience engineering and performance or capacity management.
* Cloud and container operations related to billing platforms and services.
* AIOps or GenAI\-assisted operational support capabilities.


Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* ITIL certification or billing platform certification is desirable.

We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. **Your Key Responsibilities**


* 3\-7 years of experience in designing and deploying ISC\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions.
* Configure and manage SailPoint ISC tenant, including deployment of Virtual Appliances for secure connectivity between cloud and on\-premises environments
* Integrate of different auth sources and create identity profiles with transforms.
* Manage identity lifecycle through Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver processes.
* Develop workflows and custom forms for access requests and access review modules.
* Write and maintain Cloud Rules using Java/BeanShell for complex attribute transformations.
* Build and configure connectors for systems like Active Directory, Azure AD, Workday, Web Services, and JDBC.
* Work with SailPoint REST APIs for bulk operations, custom reporting, and external integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Demonstrate strong understanding of JSON, XML, REST/SOAP, and SCIM protocols.
* Stay updated on latest ISC modules and functionalities such as AI and CIEM.
* Sailpoint engineer certification is preferred

  


**What we offer you**



At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.



Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.


To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

  


**Our Commitment**: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.


**Professional Development**: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.


**People and Culture**: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.


**Benefits**: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.


**How to Apply**: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.



Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.



“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Specialist
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.


Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


**Job Role:**

You will be a windchill developer. Their responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing software components, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and ensuring the quality and performance of the platform. They also work on enhancing the user experience, tailoring tasks to specific organizational needs, and providing support to users.
 

Core Responsibilities:


* Software Design and Development: Designing and implementing new features, functionalities, and improvements for the product using Java, J2EE, and web technologies.
* Code Quality and Maintenance: Writing clean, efficient, and well\-documented code that adheres to PTC's coding standards and best practices, ensuring the software is maintainable and scalable.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Developing and executing test plans, identifying and resolving software defects, and ensuring the platform meets the required quality standards.
* Collaboration and Communication: Working closely with product managers, UX designers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of the platform.
* Technical Documentation: Creating and maintaining technical documentation for the software, including design specifications, code documentation, and user guides.
* Performance Optimization: Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, optimizing the platform for speed and efficiency.
* Staying Up\-to\-Date: Keeping abreast of new technologies, trends, and best practices relevant to PTC and the broader PLM landscape.
* Troubleshooting and Support: Assisting in troubleshooting and resolving customer issues, providing technical support, and collaborating with other PTC teams to address complex problems.
* Automation: Contributing to the automation of software development and deployment processes.

**Your Impact:**

The R\&D team is working on PLM solutions to improve user Experience. Various technologies going to be used for which team is looking for highly motivated individuals with appropriate skills.


**Your Team:**

Candidate will be part of our R\&D team based in Pune.


**Your Day\-to\-Day:**

* Participate and Provide required information in scrum ceremonies.
* Manage major and minor release deliverables by following SDLC standards.
* Technically guides colleagues on design and implementation techniques.
* Analyze the functional requirements specification given by SMEs.
* Design the applications.
* Implement the applications according to approved designs.
* Conduct rigorous testing of the applications.
* Deploy the applications to cloud computing infrastructure.
* Perform technical reviews on the design \& solutions from your colleagues.
* Remain current on PTC technology solutions and develop skills on emerging technologies, as needed.
* Attend daily stand\-up to stay agile, share ideas, give feedback, and stay on track.

**Required Skills:**

* Candidate should be comfortable with Server\-Side as well as Client\-Side technologies.
* Programming Languages: Proficiency in Java, J2EE, and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
* Web Services: Experience with RESTful APIs and other web service technologies.
* Familiarity with MLOPs/AIOps/LLMOps tools is added advantage.
* Database Knowledge: Familiarity with relational databases like Oracle or MS SQL Server.
* Cloud Technologies: Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP is beneficial.
* Agile Development: Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to debug and resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience with PTC Products: Experience with PTC's Windchill PLM system and ThingWorx platform is added advantage.
* Experience with Content Management, Page Layout, and Publishing software is also helpful.
  

  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.


If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We are seeking an experienced Oracle BRM Billing SME / Service Lead to provide end\-to\-end operational ownership of Billing and Revenue Management services. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable billing operations, bill run processing, invoice posting, call processing, discrepancy management, service transitions, production support, major incident recovery, automation initiatives and continual service improvement. * Strong understanding of Oracle BRM architecture, administration and operational support.
* Deep knowledge of telecom billing, rating, charging, invoicing, payments, collections, discounts, taxation and dunning processes.
* Experience with BRM product and pricing configuration, utility management, opcode troubleshooting and process\-level analysis.
* Knowledge of CDR processing, suspense management, recycling processes and revenue assurance controls.
* Strong exposure to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles and operational excellence practices.
* Understanding of AI\-driven optimisation within billing and operational support functions.
* Advanced Unix/Linux administration, Shell scripting, Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills.
* Experience performing application and database log analysis, batch scheduling and performance troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Splunk, Zabbix or Datadog.
* Familiarity with PDC, ECE, OCOMC, BI Publisher, WebLogic, Oracle databases and Control\-M.
* Exposure to cloud technologies, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and modern operational practices.
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-based Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request and Service Transition management.
* Excellent analytical, stakeholder management, communication and technical leadership capabilities.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. ITIL certification is desirable.
**What’s in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to work within a global telecom environment supporting business\-critical billing platforms.
* Exposure to large\-scale Oracle BRM ecosystems and complex BSS landscapes.
* Ownership of strategic service transition and operational transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to drive automation, observability and reliability improvements across enterprise services.
* Collaboration with cross\-functional teams, technology partners and stakeholders across multiple markets.
* Involvement in AI\-driven optimisation and continuous improvement programmes.

------------------------------


* Advanced Oracle BRM operational leadership and service ownership.
* Telecom billing assurance and revenue protection methodologies.
* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices within large\-scale telecom environments.
* Enterprise observability, monitoring and proactive service management techniques.
* Service transition, operational readiness and stabilisation best practices.

About the Role
  

As a Product Support Representative III on the Rapid Response team, you will serve as a critical first point of contact for customers seeking timely, effective support across multiple channels. This advanced\-level individual contributor role focuses on independently resolving complex customer issues, leading high\-impact interactions, and serving as a technical and operational resource for the Rapid Response team.
  

  

Support provided in this role centers on application use, configuration assistance, and troubleshooting/diagnostic efforts for UKG Workforce Management (ProWFM) timekeeping solutions and related ancillary products. Representatives apply structured problem\-solving techniques, supported by AI\-powered tools and internal resources, to identify root causes, validate findings, and guide customers toward effective outcomes.
  

  

This role operates in a fast\-paced, metric\-driven environment, emphasizing a phone\-first approach to support as a key channel, alongside case\-based and written interactions. Team members are expected to incorporate AI\-powered tools into daily workflows to support troubleshooting, decision\-making, and efficient case handling. Proficiency with AI is developed through training and coaching, with consistent use expected from day one.
  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

* Serve as a first point of contact for customer inquiries related to products supported via a phone\-first approach and digital support channels, with a focus on rapid and effective triage.

* Advance knowledge and add value by becoming proficient in multiple UKG product disciplines

  

Preferred Skills \& Experience
  

* 4–6\+ years of progressive experience in service and/or technical support roles, with demonstrated success resolving complex issues independently.
* Prior experience supporting timekeeping, workforce management, or payroll\-related solutions is strongly preferred.

* Capability to work independently and as part of a cohesive team.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in real\-time customer interactions.
* Ability to remain calm, organized, and effective in high\-volume or high\-pressure environments.
* Comfort using AI\-powered tools, knowledge bases, and guided workflows, with a willingness to learn and adapt.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess issues, identify patterns, and follow structured troubleshooting processes.

What We Value
  

* Empathy and a customer\-first mindset.
* Strong judgment in determining resolution versus escalation.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality case handling.
* Coachability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
* Collaboration and respect for shared team success.

  

Growth \& Development
  

UKG is committed to supporting your development from day one. This role includes a structured onboarding program, hands\-on training, and ongoing coaching to build confidence in product knowledge, AI\-assisted support practices, and customer engagement skills. As you grow, you’ll gain exposure to more complex issues, expanded responsibilities, and future career opportunities within Support and across the organization.

**Job Summary:**

· Sits at the intersection of engineering, solutions architecture, and customer outcomes.

· Makes Fonazo work live inside an enterprise customer's telephony, CRM, compliance, and operating environment.

· Remote but active — works across time zones, joins customer calls in their hours, and travels on\-site when deployments require it.

· Carries full ownership: customer success is personal success, and field learnings shape the core product roadmap.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* **Own enterprise deployments end\-to\-end.** Take full accountability from scoping through go\-live and into steady state — running technical discovery with customer engineering and operations teams, designing the integration architecture, and being the person accountable for the system actually working in production.
* **Run technical discovery with customer teams.** Sit with customer engineering and operations stakeholders to understand their telephony estate, CRM, compliance regime, and operating language before designing how Fonazo fits into their world.
* **Design integration architecture.** Map out how Fonazo connects to a customer's existing stack — deciding what talks to what, how data flows, and where the platform's boundaries sit within their environment.
* **Build integrations across diverse enterprise systems.** Develop the connective tissue between Fonazo and customer CRMs, calendaring systems, ticketing platforms, telephony infrastructure, data warehouses, and internal APIs — frequently in environments where documentation is incomplete and access is gated behind enterprise security review.
* **Debug real\-time voice issues live, under pressure.** Diagnose latency, audio quality, and reliability problems across the full call path — from carrier to application layer — often while on a live call with the customer, and do it with composure.
* **Translate between technical and business worlds.** Convert a bank's compliance requirement into a technical configuration, a hospital operations team's workflow into an agent design, and a customer escalation into a precise, actionable engineering ticket for the core team.
* **Build reusable deployment infrastructure.** Write internal runbooks, deployment templates, and tooling so that each completed deployment makes the next one faster and more repeatable.
* **Train customers for independence.** Enable customer teams to operate the platform on their own after go\-live, reducing long\-term dependency on direct support.
* **Serve as the two\-way voice between customer and product.** Be the strongest technical voice the customer hears from Blessing Softtech, and the strongest customer voice that reaches the core product team — feeding field learnings back into what gets built next.

**Requirements**

* **Engineering depth:** 3\+ years professional software engineering in Python and TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable owning full service lifecycle — API design, auth, webhooks, queues, retries, logging, monitoring.
* **Telephony fluency:** Hands\-on experience with SIP, WebRTC, RTP, or platforms like Twilio, Plivo, or Exotel; understands codecs, jitter, packet loss, DTMF, call routing, and SIP traces.
* **AI systems experience:** Practical production LLM experience — orchestration, prompt/context design, tool calling, retrieval, evaluation, and failure handling.
* **Integration craft:** Track record with Salesforce, HubSpot, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365, including OAuth, rate limits, webhooks, and data mapping; n8n/Zapier experience a plus.
* **Infrastructure competence:** Working knowledge of Linux, Docker, cloud networking, DNS, TLS, VPNs, and firewalls; observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse) a strong plus.
* **Regulatory awareness:** Comfortable discussing DPDP Act, GDPR, and TCPA; designs systems that stay compliant by default.
* **Language:** Exceptional written and spoken English required; Arabic, Hindi, or a major European language is a meaningful advantage.

**Ideal Temperament**

* Stays calm and composed in front of customers when systems break.
* Prefers owning outcomes over just closing tickets.
* Moves fluidly from technical packet analysis to CIO\-level architecture presentations.
* Documents proactively and treats every deployment as product improvement, not just delivery.

description:

**Your Day at Altera Digital Health**

The **Senior Network Architect** is a highly skilled subject matter expert responsible for designing, architecting, and leading complex and strategic network initiatives.


This role involves setting network technology standards, driving innovation, and providing technical leadership in network infrastructure design and implementation.


The Senior Network Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping network strategies and ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.

**Experience:** 15–18\+ Years
  

**Certification:** **CCIE – Mandatory**

* Lead the design and architecture of advanced network solutions, including **LAN, WAN, Data Center, Cloud, and Hybrid Cloud environments** .
* Develop highly scalable, secure, resilient, and high\-performing network architectures to meet current and future business requirements.
* Define and establish network technology standards, best practices, architecture principles, and technology roadmaps.
* Evaluate new networking technologies and recommend their adoption based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to strategic network initiatives that align with the company's long\-term technology and business goals.
* Introduce innovative solutions and approaches to enhance network performance, security, availability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Lead and manage network projects from inception through completion.
* Ensure project objectives are achieved, resources are allocated effectively, and project milestones are delivered successfully.

* Extensive understanding of advanced networking concepts, protocols, architectures, and services.
* Extensive proficiency in designing, configuring, and managing complex network environments, including **routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, SD\-WAN, and cloud networking technologies** .

* Extensive experience with **Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud networking** .
* Strong understanding of network security architecture, firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, network segmentation, and secure connectivity.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with network monitoring, analysis, troubleshooting, and performance management tools.
* Excellent documentation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Extensive proficiency in network administration, configuration, and architecture tools.
* Proven experience leading and managing large\-scale network architecture, transformation, and migration projects.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures.
* Strong ability to align network strategies and technology roadmaps with business objectives.
Ability to work effectively with global teams, senior leadership, vendors, service providers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.  
* 

  

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in **Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field** .
* **Active CCIE certification is mandatory.**
* Preferred CCIE specializations include:
	+ CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure
	+ CCIE Service Provider
	+ CCIE Security
* Relevant cloud certifications such as **Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud** are preferred.
* Additional networking or security certifications are an advantage.

**Required Experience**

* **Minimum 15–18\+ years of experience in the Network and Security domain.**
* Extensive experience in network engineering, architecture, and progressively responsible technical leadership roles.
* Extensive experience working in large\-scale enterprise networking environments.
* Extensive experience designing and architecting complex **LAN and WAN** environments.
* Extensive experience with **network security** and enterprise security architectures.
* Extensive experience with **Data Center networking and connectivity** .
* Extensive experience with **cloud networking, including Azure and/or AWS** .
* Extensive experience with **SD\-WAN and software\-defined networking (SDN)** concepts.
* Proven experience with network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
* Proven experience working with network vendors, ISPs, cloud providers, and technology partners.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership and architectural direction to engineering and operations teams.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* **15–18\+ years of relevant Network and Security experience.**
* **Active CCIE certification – Mandatory.**
* Strong enterprise network architecture and design experience.
* Expert\-level Cisco networking experience.
* Strong expertise in **BGP, OSPF, MPLS, SD\-WAN, LAN/WAN, and Data Center networking** .
* Strong experience with network security technologies.
* Strong experience with cloud and hybrid network architectures.
* Proven experience leading complex network projects and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

description:

#### **Position Summary**


Zelite is hiring a Microsoft AI Consultant to design, build, and deliver AI solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem for enterprise clients – spanning Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, and the Power Platform. * Strong understanding of OneLake architecture and data lake design patterns
* Experience migrating legacy application/data warehouse workloads to Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including workspace, semantic model, and capacity migration

* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility – Copilot agents, declarative agents, Graph connectors

* Power Platform AI tooling – AI Builder, Power Automate AI flows, Copilot in Power Apps
* Familiarity with Dataverse as a data layer for AI solutions
* Power BI, including AI\-powered visuals and Copilot in Power BI
* Understanding of Azure Machine Learning and/or Azure AI (Cognitive) Services is a plus

#### **Qualifications and Experience**


* 4\-7 years of experience in Microsoft cloud, data, or AI consulting/solution delivery – a mid\-level position (Consultant/Senior Consultant), not entry\-level or a principal/lead role

* Relevant Microsoft certifications preferred: DP\-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), AI\-102 (Azure AI Engineer), PL\-400 or PL\-600 (Power Platform), or equivalent

* Prior experience in a client\-facing consulting environment

#### **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills**


* Experience with Dynamics 365 (Sales, Business Central, Field Service, Sales, F\&O etc.)
* Exposure to broader Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Azure DevOps)
* Familiarity with other Microsoft AI offerings – Security Copilot, Sales Copilot, GitHub Copilot
* Industry domain experience (manufacturing, pharma, FMCG, or professional services)
* Experience with agentic AI or multi\-agent orchestration frameworks

#### **Soft Skills and Other Requirements**


* Strong client\-facing communication and presentation skills
* Ability to translate technical AI concepts for non\-technical business stakeholders
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-client consulting environment
* Self\-driven, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements

#### **Submit the application on:**


* sandeep.s@zelitesolutions.com
* divyani.c@zelitesolutions.com
* hr@zelitesolutions.com

title: Agentic AI Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Category:** Agentic AI Architect
**Job Type:** Work from Office
**Job Location:** Pune
  
**Role Description**
--------------------


* The Agentic AI Architect is a senior technical leader who can architect and implement production\-grade agentic systems.
* This role blends platform architecture, hands\-on Python/LLM engineering, and enterprise governance.
* Co\-architect end\-to\-end agentic solutions: orchestration patterns, service boundaries, integration architecture, and non\-functional requirements.
* Define engineering standards and best practices for safe, observable, testable agentic workflows (tool calling, structured outputs, approvals, traceability).
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership: design reviews, reference implementations, complex debugging, and performance/scalability tuning.
* Ensure enterprise readiness: security\-by\-design, audit evidence, data controls, and operational stability across DEV/UAT/PROD.

**Location**
------------


* Pune (on\-site/hybrid).

**Experience Requirements \& Qualifications**
---------------------------------------------


**Core Experience**


* 8\+ years in software engineering / platform engineering / solution architecture, including building production backend systems.
* 2\+ years designing or building AI/LLM\-enabled systems (agentic workflows, orchestration, RAG, evaluation/monitoring).
* Proven experience operating in enterprise environments with security, compliance, and change\-management expectations (financial services preferred).
* Strong capability in distributed systems design: service decomposition, API contracts, asynchronous execution, retries/idempotency, failure isolation, and resilience.
* Experience designing workflow/agent execution architectures: worker patterns, job queues, scheduling, state management, and execution traceability.
* Ability to translate ambiguous objectives into implementable architecture and delivery plans (tradeoffs, risks, phased rollouts).
* Advanced Python engineering skills: clean architecture, modularity, testability, performance profiling, packaging, and secure coding.
* Strong experience building API\-first services (FastAPI or equivalent), including auth patterns (OAuth2/JWT/API keys), versioning, and backwards compatibility.
* Strong schema/data contract practice using typed models and validation (e.g., Pydantic\-style patterns).
* Deep understanding of reliable LLM interaction patterns, tool/function calling, and safe tool execution boundaries.
* Experience in implementing and integrating MCP servers for agentic use cases.
* Multi\-step planning/routing, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop approvals.
* Grounding and retrieval patterns (RAG), citation/evidence generation, and prompt/version management.
* Strong understanding of different agentic frameworks, strengths, weaknesses, and ability to suggest custom framework designs.
* Test harnesses, golden datasets, regression testing for prompts/agents.
* Safety testing, hallucination mitigation strategies, and cost/performance controls.
* Observability: application event tracking, traces, metrics, decision logs, prompt lineage, dashboards, prediction capabilities, run replay.

**Platform / DevOps Awareness (Strong Preference)**


Comfortable with on\-prem/cloud infra:


* Collaborate with infra teams on on\-prem / hybrid environments.
* Containers (Docker), Kubernetes/OpenShift fundamentals (deployments, secrets, ingress).
* Logging/monitoring patterns, production readiness, capacity planning.
* Secrets management, RBAC, audit logging, and environment separation.

**Nice\-to\-Have**


* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph\-like patterns) and LLM observability tools (Langfuse\-like capabilities).
* Experience working with open\-source frameworks and customizing existing agent frameworks to support complex business requirements.
* Experience with enterprise\-hosted LLMs, and designing vendor\-agnostic model abstraction layers.
* Exposure to orchestration tools such as n8n (good to have), especially for trigger/action workflows and enterprise automation.

**Main Tasks and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------


**1\) Co\-Architect Enterprise Agentic Solutions**


* Co\-own the reference architecture for agentic solutions (components, interfaces, execution model, security controls).
* Define solution patterns for routing/planning agents, tool execution agents, retrieval/grounding, approvals, and escalation paths.
* Define multi\-agent or multi\-step workflows with deterministic control points.
* Define evidence capture, explainability notes, and audit\-ready outputs.

**2\) Establish Engineering Standards \& Best Practices**


* Create and enforce standards for prompt/agent versioning, structured output contracts, and validation.
* Safe tool execution (permissions, allow\-lists, constrained actions).
* Error handling, retries, idempotency, and compensating actions.
* Logging/tracing conventions and runbook expectations.
* Define “definition of done” for production\-grade agentic workflows (security, tests, observability, documentation).

**3\) Lead Technical Delivery**


* Lead design reviews and support implementation teams (developers, infra, analysts).
* Provide hands\-on guidance for complex builds: reference implementations, difficult integrations, performance bottlenecks, and incident triage.
* Mentor Agentic Developers; uplift overall code quality and engineering maturity through reviews and coaching.

**4\) Enterprise Security, Governance, and Risk Controls**


* Partner with security and client governance stakeholders to implement secrets handling, RBAC, identity integration patterns, and audit logging.
* Data residency and data handling controls, redaction/masking where required.
* Change/release controls and environment promotion practices.
* Ensure designs are compliant with regulated client expectations (especially BFSI).

**5\) Observability, Evaluation, and Continuous Improvement**


* Define evaluation strategy (offline \+ online): regression suites, acceptance metrics, and monitoring thresholds.
* Implement/guide observability practices: traces, metrics, cost/performance tracking, decision logs.
* Drive post\-go\-live optimization: reduce failure rates, improve determinism, control latency/cost, and improve maintainability.

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

**Delivery \& Portfolio Management**

* Monitor delivery metrics, team workload, and project health to proactively identify risks and remove obstacles.
* Ensure enhancement requests, defects, incidents, and technical debt are appropriately prioritized and addressed.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

**Requirements** :


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 7\+ years of experience in software development, enterprise systems, digital platforms, integrations, or related technology disciplines.
* 3\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical teams.
* Experience working with Agile development methodologies and software delivery processes.
* Experience supporting enterprise business systems, customer\-facing digital platforms, or integration technologies.
* Demonstrated success managing both project delivery and production support responsibilities.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Proven ability to lead teams across multiple technology domains and business functions.
* Experience leveraging AI\-enabled tools or automation to improve productivity and operational effectiveness, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, evaluate, and apply such technologies at scale.

* Above average communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to provide accurate and timely information in a succinct and easy to understand manner.
* Proven time management skills and a track record of working in a team environment successfully supporting others.
* Well\-organized, attention to detail and able to multi\-task.

title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
description:
**Who We Are**



Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

#### **The Role**



Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end\-to\-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white\-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human\-in\-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks.



As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human\-in\-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization.



Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.


#### **What You'll Do**


* Lead and manage a team of Analysts \& Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery.
* Act as a Subject matter expert \& support the team on complex document processing
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
* Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues.
* Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
* Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
* Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play\-books.
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency.

#### **Who You Are**


* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2\+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back\-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw\-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem\-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R\&D
* Highly self\-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team\-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

 **Our Values**


* **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.



PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Senior Analyst - Incident Management
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.

**Critical Incident Manager (CIM)**

**Location: Pune / Hybrid**

**Role Purpose**


As an **Critical**Incident Manager (CIM), you will lead the end\-to\-end management of business\-critical and high\-visibility production incidents, ensure rapid restoration of services and minimizing customer impact. You will direct incident response activities, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and drive effective communication strategies throughout the incident lifecycle.


The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and managing P1/P2 incidents, ensuring timely resolution within SLA commitments, driving structured incident governance, and maintaining alignment between technical teams, business stakeholders, and customers.


This position will be responsible for incident management, stakeholder communication, operational governance, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement. The focus will be on ensuring operational resilience, maintaining customer trust, improving service reliability, and driving proactive incident prevention initiatives in line with **Accelya's global business strategy, values, and mission.**

**Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Incident Ownership \& Lifecycle Management**

* Own and manage the lifecycle of critical P1/P2 and high\-priority incidents from detection through resolution and closure.
* Act as the primary escalation point for major incidents, ensuring timely engagement of appropriate stakeholders and technical teams.
* Perform impact assessments, severity classification, and incident prioritization to ensure effective response execution.
* Drive production fixes, workarounds, and mitigation plans required to restore services.

**Incident Coordination \& Bridge Management**

* Assemble and lead Incident Response Teams (IRT) across Engineering, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure, DevOps, and Support functions.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage incident bridge calls, ensuring clear accountability, ownership, and progress tracking.
* Remove operational roadblocks and maintain resolution momentum throughout the incident lifecycle.

**Stakeholder \& Customer Communication**

* Provide timely, accurate, and structured communications to customers, leadership teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure communication consistency across customer notifications, management updates, bridge calls, and service status channels.
* Manage communications for high\-impact incidents affecting strategic customers and business\-critical operations.

**Status Page \& Customer Transparency**

* Own customer\-facing status page updates for all major incidents.
* Publish clear incident updates outlining customer impact, affected services, mitigation activities, and recovery progress.
* Maintain defined communication cadence throughout incident management and restoration activities.
* Ensure alignment of messaging across all communication channels.

**RCA \& Problem Management**

* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) creation, review, quality assurance, and timely delivery.
* Identify recurring issues and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to eliminate underlying causes.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure.

**Monitoring, Governance \& Continuous Improvement**

* Proactively monitor service health and operational alerts to identify potential service disruptions.
* Lead Daily Operations Reviews (DORs), providing updates on incident trends, risks, and operational performance.
* Analyze incident patterns and service trends to identify stability improvements and automation opportunities.
* Support enhancements in monitoring, alerting, reporting dashboards, and operational tooling.
* Maintain audit\-ready incident documentation across Zendesk, Jira, RCA repositories, and reporting systems.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Product, DevOps, and Support teams to improve service reliability and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with external vendors and technology partners during critical incidents when required.
* Ensure accountability, ownership, and adherence to escalation processes across all stakeholder groups.

**Operational Excellence**

* Drive accountability throughout incident management, ensuring timely service restoration and closure.
* Participate in a 24x7 rotational on\-call support model to provide uninterrupted major incident coverage.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and customer\-first service delivery.

**Required Experience \& Skills**

* Proven experience in **Major Incident Management, Service Operations, Production Support, IT Service Management, or Site Reliability Operations**.
* Strong experience managing critical P1/P2 incidents in complex enterprise or SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional technical teams during high\-pressure incident situations.
* Hands\-on experience with incident management processes aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Experience conducting incident triage, impact assessments, severity classification, and escalation management.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, customers, and technical teams.
* Experience driving Root Cause Analysis (RCA), corrective action tracking, and problem management initiatives.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based environments, distributed systems, and modern application architectures.
* Experience with ticketing and incident management tools such as Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Experience \& Skills**

* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Experience supporting airline, travel technology, SaaS, or mission\-critical enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or cloud\-native operational environments.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Splunk, or Dynatrace.
* Experience driving automation initiatives within operational support environments.
* Exposure to SRE, DevOps, Problem Management, and Change Management practices.
* Experience creating executive dashboards and operational reporting metrics.

**What do we offer?**

* Open culture and challenging opportunity to satisfy intellectual needs
* Flexible working hours
* Smart working: hybrid remote/office working environment
* Work\-life balance
* Excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment

**About Accelya**

*Accelya is a leading global software provider to the airline industry, powering 200\+ airlines with an open, modular software platform that enables innovative airlines to drive growth, delight their customers and take control of their retailing.*

*Owned by Vista Equity Partners long\-term perennial fund and with 2K\+ employees based around 10 global offices, Accelya are trusted by industry leaders to deliver now and deliver for the future.*

*The company's passenger, cargo, and industry platforms support airline retailing from offer to settlement, both above and below the wing. Accelya is proud to deliver leading\-edge technologies to its customers, including through its partnership with AWS and through the pioneering NDC expertise of its Global Product teams.*

*We are proud to enable innovation\-led growth for the airline industry and put control back in the hands of airlines.*


For more information, please visit **www.accelya.com**.


What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**


**Location\- Pune**


### **What you will do**



As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands\-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.



Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.



The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.


**How you will do it:**


* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud\-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo\-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown\-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo\-blocking and reduction of the internet\-facing attack surface.


**What we look for:**


**Required**


* Deep, hands\-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on\-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security\-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
* Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
* Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi\-phase / multi\-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
* Strong vendor management experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
* Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
* Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
* 8\&\#43; years of proven, hands\-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.

* CISSP, CEH, CISM or CISA certifications is a plus.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking an experienced Pega Business Architect / Business Analyst to lead requirements discovery, process design, and delivery governance for Pega Business Process Management (BPM) and Case Management implementations. Based in Pune with a hybrid working model requiring office attendance two days per week, this role will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, translating operational transformation objectives into scalable Pega workflow solutions. The position is ideally suited to professionals with strong expertise in Pega BPM, process modelling, stakeholder engagement, and Agile delivery environments.

**What you’ll do**
------------------



Lead requirements workshops with business stakeholders and delivery teams to capture and document current and future\-state process flows for Pega BPM initiatives.  

Model and document end\-to\-end business processes using BPMN, case lifecycles, and workflow diagrams to support solution delivery.  

Design case types, stages, processes, flows, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) within the Pega Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives.  

Collaborate with Pega architects and developers to ensure workflow designs align with platform best practices, case management capabilities, and enterprise architecture standards.  

Conduct fit\-gap assessments between business requirements and Pega platform capabilities, recommending configuration\-led solutions where appropriate.  

Define and govern business rules, decision tables, decision trees, routing logic, and escalation workflows.  

Maintain end\-to\-end traceability from business requirements through design, testing, and deployment.

**Who you are**
---------------



Experience of 5\+ years in enterprise IT and business analysis, including 4\+ years focused on Pega implementations.  

Strong functional expertise in Pega BPM and Case Management, including case design, stages, processes, SLAs, work parties, and routing.  

Proficiency in BPMN process modelling and translating business processes into effective Pega case designs.  

Working knowledge of Pega decisioning capabilities including decision tables, decision trees, and when rules.  

Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies, ideally SAFe, with exposure to Scrum and Kanban practices.  

Ability to create high\-quality business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and user stories.  

Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across business, architecture, engineering, testing, data, and integration teams.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------



Opportunity to shape enterprise\-wide business transformation programmes through Pega BPM and Case Management solutions.  

Exposure to multi\-market and global stakeholder environments.

description:
### **Job Information**
